reason: The premise is correct. In exp79a, coordinject (cell 8) runs after the repair loop (cell 7, DIVINS gate 28800 s from KERNEL_START_TS), so 'did NOT fire' needs a true lower bound on CI time. The 2.2 h model is not supported: same-batch dL vs exp78b is about (1.82-1.88, 2.18] h, and dL vs the code-identical exp70g is (1.60, 1.96] h. The proposed action still fails. (1) 9.88 h is not an honest bound either. Same-batch latencies swap by ~20 min (CONTEXT W1 order (4)), and the code-identical comparison allows CI = 1.6 h, so the proof-grade line would be about 9.6 h. (2) The distinction has almost no value. In the dummy log (_dl/biohub-exp79a-k2cap6-coordinject), the repair phase where insertion runs is the last ~37% of main time. With L_hi <= 10.2 h and CI >= 1.88 h, main overran 8.0 h by <= 0.32 h, so insertion was skipped on <= ~11% of the tail videos. Insertion is worth only ~+0.002-0.003 in total (K2 0.954 vs its twin 0.953; cap 6 = 0.956), so the confound is <= ~0.0003, below the 0.001 display step. The single hidden run fixes the private score too, so finals are unaffected. (3) It can do harm. Under CONTEXT l.3389, a CI '?' from 'v' gets no CI stack. Probe 51's expected L is ~7.5-7.8 h main + 1.6-2.2 h CI = 9.1-10.0 h, which is right in the widened window, so a sub-display confound could block a 29 Sep stack. Probe 48 (L_hi 9.45 h) reads the same under every threshold. Feasibility is trivial (a ledger label and a test), but the value is zero or negative.
fix: Do not move the 'v' or '?' boundary. Log one line before probe 51 is terminal: 'CI_lo model 2.2 h is contradicted: measured dL 1.60-2.18 h (exp79a vs exp70g / same-batch exp78b). For CI files with L_hi in (9.6, 10.2] h the insertion MAY have been skipped on the tail videos only (<= ~(L_hi - 9.6)/2.8 of the repair phase, <= 0.0005 score). The read code stays as coded, with footnote "ins-tail?". It does not block a CI stack.' Optionally change only the label text of FAMILIES['safetail_ci'] in tools/runtime_ledger.py to cite the measured dL, keeping divins_h = 10.2 so the stack rules are unchanged. If a proof-grade gate is still wanted, use 9.6 h (min over comparisons), not 9.88 h, and add the matching assertion in tests/test_runtime_ledger.py.
realistic_gain: About 0 on LB and private. It is bookkeeping only: at most ~0.0003-0.0005 of confound on a CI read in the (9.6, 10.2] h window, and no finals effect. As proposed (9.88 h -> '?', which blocks a CI stack) the expected value is slightly negative.
